additional_info.subject: Semih
additional_info.body:
We tried to flash the USB again and plugged in on KF1 but no device got recognized as you can see in the screenshots. Also tried to edit
bootinst.bat by starting it as admin but no sucess, Booting via usb keyboard also didnt helped an all lined to the conclusion that there is no recognition from the KF1 to any USB, decided to replace it

additional_info.subject: Semi
additional_info.body:
The RC got the KF1 the USB slot for live linux worked but when it comes to inserting the CFAST card the KF1 doesnt react to the fact that we insert the CFast Card into the Card Slot!!! present we had:
1 old KF1 which  USB slot didnt recognize the any USB stick
1 New KF1 which USB worked but now we have the issue That no Cfast Card is getting recognized
1 Old CFAST and 1 NEW Cfast both got flashed via companion tool with 6.0.3 still not working
actually this issue is a recuring event and will be reported in the JF Service Call on Monday.
last try is to swap to old KF1 and try toi force the USB boot up if this doesnt work then we need to order new Cfast card and KF1
